trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    if not pts:return [[bg]]
    rows=Counter(r for r,c in pts); cols=Counter(c for r,c in pts)
    heights=list(cols.values()); widths=list(rows.values())
    if len(rows)==1 or len(cols)==1:n=1
    elif len(rows)==2:
        n=min(widths) if min(widths)>1 else max(widths)
    else:n=sorted(widths)[len(widths)//2]
    return [[bg]*n]
